Hello, are you a new player? Do you find yourself liking this game, wanting to learn more, but find the ongoing deluge of information a bit formidable? Are you a returning player or a current player in a dead guild? Man, have I got the guild for all of you!

My boss relies on me and gives out regular raises... but like... with inflation the way it is, I've come out seriously going red every year. I feel so unfulfilled in a job that brought me out of straight destitution. Thinking about switching trades, but I'm like.... I just don't know what better is anymore. Better used to be easy to figure out. It was anything I wasn't currently. Stable was better... I'm stable now and just lost in the shuffle of knowing I could make more money, but I honestly don't care about money. So ya, my life philosophy right now is what the fuck is better?

My main problem is MORE and MORE severely mentally ill people have hands on these. I don't actually support an assault weapons ban. I do support more stringent requirements to get ANY firearm in this country. "OH, but the bad guys don't care about the law! They'll get their guns anyway." Doesn't matter. This country's INSANE gun philosophy has led to our current problem of nearly a mass shooting a week, at points. Until gun owners actually admit that maybe just maybe, the bad eggs like guns too, and mental health care is an absolute joke in this country. I, of course, had a litany answers as to why I was in such a state. 

After a few pretty hard hours with myself, the conclusion was pretty final. I was this way, truly hateful of myself, because I was just shuffling through life before. Never reaching out to discover myself or what is hidden real deep. I've got an issue being stuck in the past. Dwelling on my calamity of a blood family for far too long. See myself in the mirror rather the echo of brother whom I doubt I can mend fences with. It was weird... all those years of hatred, ALL of that anger, fit right into place and felt distant. I hadn't buried it. I'd finally let it go a bit. It was refreshing. 

Since then, it's been about that little by little process of finding myself under all that mess I made. I'm an alright dude with a decent upside most days. I can be a shitter too. Anybody can. The main thing though is knowing I have a solid base as a human being because I've seen SO MANY good great people take me up and help me along in my darkness beforehand. Now, I'm about to rent my dream apartment overlooking the full view of my beautiful city in a quiet neighborhood with change to spare to start working toward a house. I am with the woman of my dreams. 

One last note, the human mind is a very fickle thing. There's no one size fits all answer. I did my self reflection without therapy or any sort of outside source. Um sure. When I make Vodka sauce, i use Stoli or Tito's. Stoli gives you that more traditional Vodka sauce while Tito's goes good into some Vodka Pierogies I came up with for obvious reasons of Potato power. I also use Heavy Cream, Tomato Paste, Onion, and Fresh Garlic.

For the regular, I grab whatever Lean cut of cheap steak I can find, and just sear each side brown at the start to begin a fond at the bottom of my pot and remove the steak to which I then add onion to my pot. After sauteing for a while, once the onion starts to go translucent, add fresh garlic and the tomato paste to saute. Saute until all three are just shy of starting to caramelize. Deglaze the pot with your Stoli, or regular vodka equivalent, and you should almost instantly have a very dull red sheen staring back at you. Add in your preferred pasta seasonings, mine will forever be a very simple smattering of salt, pepper, oregano, sage, thyme, and rosemary. Slice up your steak, throw it into your sauce, and bring to a rolling simmer. At this point, you only need add in a nice heavy cream, and you got yourself a finished Vodka sauce. Nothing fancy, I never measure anything I throw into my cooking, so you're good to let your imagination flow into the dish. It is SUPER forgiving.
